item.nf:article:
{"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use Runway AI video generator: a beginner guide","dek":"What the free plan really includes, what each second of video costs, and three prompt patterns from Runway's own guides.","summary":"Runway's Gen-4.5 video model needs a paid plan and costs 12 credits per second of video. This guide covers the free plan, credit costs, the steps to a first clip, and prompts to copy.","seo_title":"How to use Runway AI video generator: a beginner guide","seo_description":"How to use Runway AI step by step: what the free plan includes, credits per second, making a Gen-4.5 video, and three prompts to copy.","answer_summary":"Open Runway on the web, choose Gen-4.5 in Video mode, type a prompt or drop in an image, pick 5, 8 or 10 seconds and click Generate. Gen-4.5 needs the Standard plan or higher and costs 12 credits per second.","tags":["Runway","AI video","Gen-4.5","Guides"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"How to use Runway AI comes down to three things: knowing which plan unlocks the video models, writing prompts in the order Runway's own guide recommends, and watching the credit cost of every clip. Runway is a web app for AI video, images and audio, and its newest video model, Gen-4.5, makes clips from a text prompt or from a still image.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: Gen-4.5","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/46974685288467"},{"name":"Runway Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/15124877443219-How-do-credits-work"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The short version: the free plan gives you 125 credits once and does not include Gen-4.5, which needs the Standard plan or higher. Gen-4.5 costs 12 credits per second of video and outputs 720p clips at 24 frames per second.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/15124877443219-How-do-credits-work"},{"name":"Runway Help Center: Gen-4.5","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/46974685288467"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What the Runway free plan gets you","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Free accounts get a one-time deposit of 125 credits. Those credits do not expire, but they also do not refresh, and free users cannot buy more, according to Runway's help center. Paid plans come with monthly credits: 625 on Standard, 2,250 on Pro and on Unlimited, and 9,500 on Max.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/15124877443219-How-do-credits-work"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"A pricing review from eesel AI, last updated August 31, 2026, says the free plan covers text to image, text to speech and the image and audio apps, while the Gen-4 and Gen-4.5 video models need Standard or higher. It lists Standard at $12 per user per month billed yearly, about $15 month to month, and Pro at $28 per user per month billed yearly, about $35 month to month.","sources":[{"name":"eesel AI: Runway AI pricing in 2026","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/en/blog/runway-ai-pricing"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Monthly credits on Standard, Pro and Unlimited do not roll over: they reset within 24 hours of your billing date. Max can carry up to one month of unused credits forward. Credits you buy on top of a paid plan do not expire, and the minimum purchase is 1,000 credits.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/15124877443219-How-do-credits-work"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"In practice, the free account is a way to test Runway's image and audio tools, not its headline video model. If video is the reason you came, plan on Standard at minimum.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How much a Runway AI video costs","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Runway's credits page lists Gen-4.5 at 12 credits per second, so a 5 second clip costs 60 credits and a 10 second clip costs 120. Gen-4 also costs 12 credits per second, while Gen-4 Turbo costs 5 credits per second, or 25 credits for 5 seconds. Runway's Gen-4 guide suggests testing an idea in Turbo first and switching to the full model only if the result falls short.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/15124877443219-How-do-credits-work"},{"name":"Runway Help Center: Creating with Gen-4","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/37327109429011-Creating-with-Gen-4"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Runway's guide to the Standard plan gives its own ways to stretch credits: start with 5 second videos instead of 10, experiment with image models before moving to video, and start video generations without audio. It notes that third-party models and video with audio use credits faster, while image models and Turbo video models use fewer.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: Standard plan","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/49191105352339"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Runway's own pages do not always show the same total for every length, so check the cost shown in the app before you press Generate, not after.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to make your first Runway AI video with Gen-4.5","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Pick the model","text":"Open Runway on the web, go to Video creation mode and choose Gen-4.5 in the model selector at the bottom left. Gen-4.5 is web only, so do this in a browser, not the phone app.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Choose text or an image","text":"For Text to Video, type a prompt only. For Image to Video, drag a picture into the prompt window first, then write the prompt. The image becomes the look of the shot, so the text only has to describe what moves.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Set length and shape","text":"Pick 5, 8 or 10 seconds. Runway says prompts with several actions in a row work better with longer clips. Then choose an aspect ratio: 16:9 for YouTube, 9:16 for Reels and TikTok, 1:1 for a square post. Runway also offers 4:3, 3:4 and 21:9.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Generate and keep the good one","text":"Click Generate and wait. Under the right side of the result you can favorite, upscale or download it. The Use button on the left sends the clip on to the next tool so you can keep working on it.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Change one thing at a time","text":"If the clip is close but wrong, edit the prompt and run it again. Change one element per run so you can tell what fixed it.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Runway prompts that work (copy and paste)","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Runway's Text to Video guide says every prompt needs two parts: what is in the frame and how it moves. It recommends full sentences over a list of keywords for control, and suggests this order: the camera shot, the subject, the action, the environment, then supporting details such as light and style. Its own example is a medium shot of a cowboy on a horse in a dusty setting.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: Text to Video prompting guide","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/42460036199443"}]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 1: Text to Video, the basic structure","text":"[Camera] shot of [subject] [doing what] in [place]. [Light, weather or mood]. [How the camera moves].

Example: Medium shot of a barista pouring milk into a cup in a small cafe. Soft morning light from the window. The camera slowly pushes in.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 2: Image to Video, motion only","text":"The woman turns her head toward the camera and smiles. Her hair moves in the wind. The camera stays still.","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"For Image to Video, Runway's Gen-4 guide says the picture already sets the subject, colors, lighting and style, so the prompt should be almost entirely about motion. Text prompts there can be up to 1,000 characters.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: Creating with Gen-4","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/37327109429011-Creating-with-Gen-4"}]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 3: Timing with timestamps","text":"Close-up of a man at a desk in a dark office.
[00:00 through 00:02] he looks away, then turns toward the camera
[00:02 through 00:03] fast zoom in to frame his eyes","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Runway calls this timestamp prompting and recommends pairing the timed lines with a normal sentence. Give each action a realistic length: the guide points out that walking across a room takes about three seconds, not half a second.","sources":[{"name":"Runway Help Center: Text to Video prompting guide","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/42460036199443"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"If something you asked for does not show up, say it again more plainly. Runway's guide gives the example of changing "High angle of a koi fish pond" to "High angle looking down at a koi fish pond" to get the camera angle.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Runway is bad at","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Runway lists the weak spots itself. In its Gen-4.5 announcement from December 1, 2025, the company names errors in cause and effect, problems with object permanence, where things vanish or appear between frames, and success bias, where actions tend to work out even when they should not. Gen-4.5 output is also 720p, so upscaling costs an extra step.","sources":[{"name":"Runway: Introducing Runway Gen-4.5","url":"https://runway.com/research/introducing-runway-gen-4.5"},{"name":"Runway Help Center: Gen-4.5","url":"https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/46974685288467"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Gen-4.5 launched in first place on the Artificial Analysis Text to Video leaderboard, according to Runway, and it runs on NVIDIA GPUs. Benchmarks change fast, though, so treat a ranking as a reason to try it, not a promise.","sources":[{"name":"Runway: Introducing Runway Gen-4.5","url":"https://runway.com/research/introducing-runway-gen-4.5"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"Runway is worth it if you make short clips often and want one place for images, video and edits. If you make one video a month, the one-time free credits and a careful Turbo test will tell you more than any review.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Gemini can now read your emails while you drive
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Google started rolling out the Gemini app on Apple CarPlay on November 11, worldwide, in every language Gemini Live supports. Tap the Gemini icon on the car's screen and talk to it hands-free. Using Gmail and Calendar, it can read your daily brief, sum up unread email and help you draft spoken replies. You can cut in mid-sentence or switch topics. Chats sync with the Gemini app on your iPhone. Gemini was the last major chatbot missing from CarPlay. ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Copilot and Perplexity were already there. Sources: 9to5Google, Engadget, MacRumors, Digital Trends.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Gemini can now read your emails while you drive

item.title: How to use Canva AI: designs, slides and what each plan gets
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Tell Canva AI the format, the goal and the audience. It builds a full design you can edit. It works for social posts, presentations, websites, videos and docs. With a Brand Kit connected, Canva AI uses your colors, fonts and tone. Tag @Canva in a comment to get design feedback without writing a long prompt. Ask for one change, like a new headline or image. Canva says the rest of the design stays put. Sources: Canva Help Center: Understanding your AI usage, Canva Newsroom: Introducing Canva's Creative Operating System, 9to5Mac, Engadget, Fast Company, Tech Insider.

item.nf:article: {"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use Canva AI: designs, presentations and what each plan gets","dek":"What Canva AI can build from one description, the steps that get a usable first draft, and how the monthly AI allowance works on each plan.","summary":"Canva AI turns a written description into a complete, editable design and can generate single elements, presentations and feedback. This guide walks through the steps and explains the monthly AI allowance, from up to 20 Premium uses on Canva Free to up to 400 on Business.","seo_title":"How to use Canva AI: designs, slides and limits by plan","seo_description":"How to use Canva AI step by step: describe a design, build a presentation, use your Brand Kit, three prompts to copy, and the AI limits on each plan.","answer_summary":"Describe the design you need to Canva AI, including the format, goal and audience, and it generates a complete design you can edit piece by piece. Every plan has a monthly AI allowance, which you can check by selecting your profile icon, then Settings, then Billing.","tags":["Canva","Canva AI","AI design","Presentations","Guides"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"How to use Canva AI comes down to three habits: describe the whole design instead of one picture, edit the result one element at a time, and keep an eye on your monthly AI allowance. Canva AI is the assistant built into Canva. You describe what you need in a chat, and it generates a design you can keep editing, according to Engadget and 9to5Mac's coverage of the Canva AI 2.0 launch in April 2026.","sources":[{"name":"9to5Mac","url":"https://9to5mac.com/2026/04/16/canva-ai-2-0-introduces-memory-connectors-and-automated-workflows/"},{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/ai/canva-starts-previewing-a-more-powerful-version-of-its-ai-assistant-130000966.html"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Canva says its own Canva Design Model now powers these features. The company describes it as a model trained on design structure, layering, hierarchy and branding, and says it creates fully editable content rather than a flat image. The same model is also available inside ChatGPT and Claude, Canva says.","sources":[{"name":"Canva Newsroom: Introducing Canva's Creative Operating System","url":"https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Canva AI can make","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"According to Canva's newsroom, the main pieces are: AI-powered designs (a complete design for a social post, presentation, website, video or doc), AI-powered elements (photos, videos, icons, shapes, 3D elements and custom code from the Elements tab), Style Match (makes the look of a design consistent), Magic Background (a backdrop that fits the subject, layout and style), Guided Presentations, Magic Video and Ask @Canva, which gives feedback when you tag it in a comment.","sources":[{"name":"Canva Newsroom: Introducing Canva's Creative Operating System","url":"https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/creative-operating-system/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Two newer models sit on top of that. Canva Craft, Canva's first image generation model, launched on October 22, 2026 in the Dream Lab tab and outputs images up to 2K, Tech Insider reported. Canva Brush, launched October 29, works through a design step by step and was available only to Canva Pro subscribers at launch, according to Fast Company.","sources":[{"name":"Fast Company","url":"https://www.fastcompany.com/91633207/could-canva-brush-new-ai-feature-end-graphic-design-slop"},{"name":"Tech Insider","url":"https://tech-insider.org/canva-craft-first-image-model-designarena-2026/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to use Canva AI, step by step","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Start from the Canva AI chat","text":"Canva AI 2.0 is a conversational interface: you type what you need and it creates, edits and organizes the work. It launched as a research preview starting from the Canva homepage, with access widening over time, so the exact entry point can differ by account.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Describe the whole design, not one image","text":"Say the format, the goal, the audience and the tone in one message. Canva AI is built to generate a complete design with structure and layout, so a full brief gets you a usable first draft instead of a random picture.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 1: A social post from a brief","text":"Make an Instagram carousel of 5 slides announcing [event] on [date] at [place]. Audience: [who]. Tone: friendly and clear. Put the date and place on the first slide and a call to sign up on the last.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. For a deck, use Guided Presentations","text":"Canva says Guided Presentations is a conversational flow on the Canva AI homepage that first asks about your goal, then helps shape the story and structure the slides before you pick a layout. Answer its questions properly: the outline you agree on decides how good the slides are.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 2: A presentation outline","text":"I need a 10 slide presentation for [audience] about [topic]. The goal is to get them to [decision or action]. Use one idea per slide, end with a slide of next steps, and keep text under 25 words per slide.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Connect your Brand Kit","text":"Once a Brand Kit is connected, Canva AI generates designs that reflect the brand's colors, fonts, tone and style, according to Canva. Engadget also reported a brand tool that applies a company's visual identity to new and existing designs. Do this before you generate, not after.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Change one element at a time","text":"Canva AI 2.0 edits only the element you name, such as an image, a headline or a font, 9to5Mac reported. Ask for small, specific changes. If the parts of a design look mismatched, try Style Match; if the background looks empty, try Magic Background.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 3: A targeted fix","text":"Keep everything else the same. Replace the headline on slide 1 with a shorter one under 8 words, and make the photo on slide 3 warmer and brighter.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"6. Ask @Canva for feedback","text":"Tag @Canva in a comment on your design. Canva says it gives design feedback and can generate visuals, using fonts, colors and tone that fit, without extra prompts.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Canva AI limits on each plan","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Every plan has one monthly AI allowance shared by Standard, Premium and Ultra tools, and Premium and Ultra tools use more of it per use. On Canva Free and Pro Lite, Standard tools count toward the allowance, with up to 20 Premium uses shared with Standard, and no Ultra tools. Canva Pro, Teams and Nonprofits get up to 200 Premium uses and up to 20 Ultra uses, and Standard tools such as Magic Write and Translate do not count. Business and Enterprise get up to 400 Premium and up to 40 Ultra uses.","sources":[{"name":"Canva Help Center: Understanding your AI usage","url":"https://www.canva.com/help/ai-access/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The numbers are a best case. Canva says they assume simple prompts and the cheapest tool in each category, and that Canva AI 2.0 conversational design uses more than single prompt features, rising with the size of the design, the complexity of the task and the model needed. Designs made through ChatGPT or Claude connected to Canva also draw from your allowance.","sources":[{"name":"Canva Help Center: Understanding your AI usage","url":"https://www.canva.com/help/ai-access/"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"To see what is left, select your profile icon, then Settings, then Billing, and look under AI usage. Free allowances reset at midnight UTC on the first of each month; paid plans reset on the billing date.","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"When you run out on Free, Canva adds short pauses between Standard and Premium generations and blocks Ultra tools until the reset. You can upgrade, buy an AI Pass or a top-up where your plan allows it, or wait.","sources":[{"name":"Canva Help Center: Understanding your AI usage","url":"https://www.canva.com/help/ai-access/"},{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/ai/canva-starts-previewing-a-more-powerful-version-of-its-ai-assistant-130000966.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Where Canva AI falls short","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The allowance is the real limit. Chat-style editing is the most useful part of Canva AI and also the most expensive per request, so a long back and forth on a big deck can use far more of a Free month than the headline number suggests. Some of the newest tools, like Brush, started on paid plans only, and the AI 2.0 assistant rolled out gradually, so not every account sees the same features at the same time. Treat the first draft as a layout to edit, check every fact and number in it yourself, and spend your AI uses on the changes that would take longest by hand.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to use Kling AI to make videos, and what is really free
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Kling sells credits at $1 for 66. Failed runs are refunded. A 5 second 720p clip with no audio costs 30 credits on VIDEO 3.0. Label shots in order: framing, camera move, action. Mark moments like "At the 3rd second" and give each line of dialogue a speaker and tone. The Multi-Shot switch lets the model plan the cuts. Sources: Kling AI: Credits policy, Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 model user guide, Atlas Cloud: How to get Kling AI free credits, Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 Omni model user guide, Let's Data Science: Kling AI opens Kling 4.0.

item.nf:article: {"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use Kling AI to make videos (free credits explained)","dek":"What the free account really gives you, what each second costs, and three prompt patterns from Kling's own guide.","summary":"Kling AI charges credits for every second of video, at $1 for 66 credits, and refunds failed runs. This guide explains the free credits, the cost per clip, and how to make your first video step by step.","seo_title":"How to use Kling AI to make videos (free credits explained)","seo_description":"How to use Kling AI step by step: free credits, what each video costs, three prompts to copy, Multi-Shot, and what Kling 4.0 adds.","answer_summary":"Sign in at kling.ai, check your credits in the left sidebar, start from text or an image, pick 3 to 15 seconds and 720p or 1080p, and write the prompt as a shot list. A 5 second 720p clip without audio costs 30 credits on Kling VIDEO 3.0.","tags":["Kling AI","AI video","Kuaishou","Guides"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"How to use Kling AI to make videos comes down to three things: knowing what the free account really gives you, writing prompts the way Kling's own guide asks for, and checking the credit cost before every clip. Kling is an AI video generator from Kuaishou that turns text, images and video references into short clips with sound.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 model user guide","url":"https://kling.ai/quickstart/klingai-video-3-model-user-guide"},{"name":"Let's Data Science: Kling AI opens Kling 4.0","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/kling-ai-opens-kling-40-to-all-users-d9dc6422"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The quick version: credits are Kling's currency, a video costs credits for every second you generate, and failed generations are refunded. Kling sells credits at a standard rate of $1 for 66 credits. A 5 second clip at 720p without audio costs 30 credits on the Kling VIDEO 3.0 model, according to Kling's own user guide.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: Credits policy","url":"https://kling.ai/docs/point-policy"},{"name":"Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 model user guide","url":"https://kling.ai/quickstart/klingai-video-3-model-user-guide"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Kling AI free credits explained","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Kling's credit policy lists several kinds of credits: promotional credits from events, monthly credits that come with a membership and last one month, credits from a 7 day membership, daily login credits that subscribers can claim during events, and purchased credits that stay valid for two years. When you generate, Kling spends the credits that expire soonest first.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: Credits policy","url":"https://kling.ai/docs/point-policy"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The policy does not promise a fixed free allowance. A third-party guide from Atlas Cloud, published July 14, 2026, says the free plan gets 66 credits on the first login of each month, valid for one month, which is enough for about two 5 second clips at 720p. Treat that number as a guide, not a promise, and check your own balance.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: Credits policy","url":"https://kling.ai/docs/point-policy"},{"name":"Atlas Cloud: How to get Kling AI free credits","url":"https://www.atlascloud.ai/blog/tips/kling-ai-free"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Some features are paid only. Kling's policy names fast-track generation, 1080p video, watermark removal, master shot and video extension, and image upscaling as premium features that credits alone do not unlock. Atlas Cloud adds that free output carries a watermark and that the free queue can be too busy to accept new tasks at peak times.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: Credits policy","url":"https://kling.ai/docs/point-policy"},{"name":"Atlas Cloud: How to get Kling AI free credits","url":"https://www.atlascloud.ai/blog/tips/kling-ai-free"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"To see how many credits you have, click the remaining credits number in the left sidebar on the Kling website. Do this before you start, not after a failed run.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How much a Kling AI video costs in credits","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Kling's VIDEO 3.0 guide charges per second. With Native Audio on, it costs 12 credits a second at 1080p and 9 at 720p. With No Native Audio, it costs 8 credits a second at 1080p and 6 at 720p. Voice control adds 2 credits a second. So a 5 second 1080p clip with sound costs 60 credits, and the same clip with voice control costs 70.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 model user guide","url":"https://kling.ai/quickstart/klingai-video-3-model-user-guide"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The VIDEO 3.0 Omni model, which can also take a video as a reference, costs 16 credits a second at 1080p and 12 at 720p when you add a video input, with native audio off. Clips on both 3.0 models run from 3 to 15 seconds.","sources":[{"name":"Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 model user guide","url":"https://kling.ai/quickstart/klingai-video-3-model-user-guide"},{"name":"Kling AI: VIDEO 3.0 Omni model user guide","url":"https://kling.ai/quickstart/klingai-video-3-omni-model-user-guide"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to make your first Kling AI video","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Log in and check your balance","text":"Go to kling.ai and sign in. Credits only work for logged-in users. Click the credits number in the left sidebar so you know your budget.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Choose how to start","text":"Kling VIDEO 3.0 supports text to video, image to video, and video from a start frame and an end frame. If you have a still you like, start from the image: you only describe the motion, and you waste fewer runs on a look you did not want.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Pick length, resolution and audio","text":"Set a length between 3 and 15 seconds and choose 720p or 1080p. Choose Native Audio if you want sound and speech, or No Native Audio to save credits. For a test, use 720p without audio and keep it short.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Write the prompt like a shot list","text":"Kling's guide asks you to label shots in order and describe framing and camera movement for each one. You can mark timed moments, give every line of dialogue a speaker and a tone, and ask for an accent.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 1: One clean shot","text":"A single unbroken shot with no edited transitions. Slow push-in on [subject] in [place] at [time of day], soft light from the left, shallow depth of field. At the 3rd second, [subject] turns and looks at the camera.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 2: A short multi-shot scene","text":"Shot 1, wide shot of [person] walking into [place], cinematic handheld.\nShot 2, close-up of [person]'s face as they notice [thing].\n[Person] (softly, in a surprised tone): [one short line of dialogue].","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 3: Text that must stay readable","text":"The camera remains fixed on the word \"[WORD]\" printed on [object], then slowly pulls back to show [scene].","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Use Multi-Shot when you need cuts","text":"In the VIDEO 3.0 input area, turn on the Multi-Shot switch and the model plans the shots itself. Then click Custom Multi-Shot to set the number of shots, how long each one runs and what happens in each.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"6. Keep a character the same across clips","text":"Upload an image and use Bind Subject to Enhance Consistency, or build an element from 2 to 4 reference images. For a talking character, you can upload a short video to create a character element with its own voice.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Kling 4.0 changes","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Kuaishou says Kling 4.0 launched on October 15, 2026, after early access from September 30. The company says it makes clips of up to 30 seconds in one pass, accepts up to 15 reference assets and up to 10 keyframes, and can be used by AI agents through a Kling MCP and command line tool. Kuaishou did not publish 4.0 prices in that announcement, so check the cost on your own screen before you try it.","sources":[{"name":"Let's Data Science: Kling AI opens Kling 4.0","url":"https://letsdatascience.com/news/kling-ai-opens-kling-40-to-all-users-d9dc6422"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Where Kling AI falls short","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"Kling is strong at short, controlled shots with sound, and its prompt guide is unusually specific. The weak spot is cost. Every re-roll spends credits, 1080p and watermark removal sit behind a paid plan, and a free monthly allowance of about two short clips leaves very little room to experiment. Draft at 720p without audio, then spend on the version you keep.","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"Long prompts do not save a bad idea. One clear subject, one camera move and one action per shot will beat a paragraph of adjectives. If a generation fails, check your balance: Kling says failed generations are refunded.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Kling translates prompts in unsupported languages into English. Its 3.0 guide lists five supported languages for speech: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to use Higgsfield AI, and what you really get for free
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: No free trial. The free tier gives a small set of models and no credits. Paid plans add monthly credits, more models and Unlimited access to some models on mid and top plans. Open AI Video, press Create Video Now and choose Kling, Seedance, Veo or another model.
